data.long_meaning: In Hebrew and Greek, Aday translates to 'first light' or 'dawn.' In the Bible, the name Aday is not explicitly mentioned but can be linked to Adam, which means 'man' or 'earth.' The first man, Adam, was created at dawn, symbolizing the beginning of life. The name Aday carries the meaning “First light, dawn” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aday usually hope their child will grow to embody first light, dawn and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of new beginnings and the dawn of a new life.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aday total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

The name Aday serves as a constant reminder of this divine origin, instilling a deeper appreciation for the complexity and value of life. It also highlights the importance of the spiritual journey, encouraging individuals to seek God in their daily lives and strive towards personal and spiritual growth.
